records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue from sales to customers in Asia was 94% and 93% of our total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The semiconductor industry has historically been impacted by various macroeconomic challenges including fluctuations in consumer spending, fluctuations in demand for semiconductors, rising inflation, increased interest rates, and fluctuations in currency rates.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2025, the $8.3 million increase in net cash provided by operating activities compared to the same period in 2024 was primarily due to increased accounts receivable collections, partially offset by increased inventory purchases and changes in other working capital.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Cost of revenue was $284.3 million, or 44.6% of revenue, for the three months ended March 31, 2025, and $205.4 million, or 44.9% of revenue, for the three months ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2025, the $8.5 million decrease in net cash used in investing activities compared to the same period in 2024 was primarily due to a $33.3 million acquisition made in 2024, partially offset by an increase of $24.4 million in purchases of property and equipment.
